mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library and we are currently in a third quarter moon phase.

Deputy Chief Liz Gay officially began her duties on November 2, bringing an extensive background in EMS and healthcare instructor development to the Fitch-Rona EMS department. Additionally, residents are reminded that refuse and recycling collection is managed by Pellitteri Waste Systems, with carts needing to be placed out by 7 AM.

There is plenty to do with trivia happening today at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, tomorrow features live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza with a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee.

In a noteworthy incident on October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for O W I after he was discovered unresponsive behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor is Turtle Cheesecake. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to plan your visit.
